page.overview:
Who is Ra Yellow?

Ra Yellow (ラー・イエロー Rā Ierō) is a location in Yu-Gi-Oh! GX. It is the average-ranked dormitory at Duel Academy and is mostly made up of students with average or excellent grades. The headmaster of the dormitory is Professor Sartyr.

The dorm is named after the Egyptian God Card, "The Winged Dragon of Ra", which was previously owned by Marik Ishtar/Yami Marik during the Battle City tournament in the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime. The students are skilled Duelists and they are known for being both smart and cunning, which are among Marik's most defining traits.

Being the middle-level dormitory in Duel Academy, the Ra Yellow dorm is designed to be more accommodating and catering than the Slifer Red dorm, but not as upscale as the Obelisk Blue dorm. The dorm features a middle-class interior design with decent rooming and a large cafeteria where the food is high quality and provided by chefs. To enroll in Ra Yellow, the student must earn excellent grades in high school, earn a high score in the entrance exams, or move up from the Slifer Red dorm.

The Ra Yellow students are identified usually by yellow uniform jackets with white trimmings that extend to the waist. The uniform jacket also features a yellow band at the cuffs, a white band around the shoulders with a button to keep the jacket closed, and a white decorative shape with a brown border on the chest of the jacket. The collar of the jacket usually sticks straight up and is also yellow with a brown border. Another band, which matches the color of the jacket, wraps around the bottom of the jacket and has a snap or button to keep the jacket closed. In addition, at the beginning of the series, another variant was seen for a male student. In , there is a male student who wears an all-yellow uniform jacket.
